headline: Park Pass Systems and Spring Capacity Management
reservation: Major theme parks require both a valid admission ticket and, in many cases, a date-specific park reservation. State parks like Wekiwa Springs often reach vehicle capacity by mid-morning on weekends, requiring an early arrival. Check official park apps and the Florida State Parks website for real-time gate closures and lightning lane protocols.

days.title: Freshwater Springs and Rivers
days.start: Suggested: 7:30 AM from Lake Buena Vista

stops.name: Wekiwa Springs State Park
stops.detail: Swim in the 72-degree natural spring head or paddle the Wekiva River to spot local turtles.

stops.name: Blue Spring State Park
stops.detail: Walk the boardwalk to observe manatees during the winter refuge season.

days.driving: Allow 1.5–2 hours; conditions vary near I-4 corridors
days.note: Arrive at springs before 8 AM during peak seasons to ensure entry.

days.title: Wetlands and Wildlife Encounters

stops.name: Lake Tohopekaliga

stops.name: Tibet-Butler Nature Preserve

days.driving: Allow 1 hour; conditions vary with local resort traffic
days.note: Check weather forecasts; airboat operations may be suspended during high winds or lightning.

intel.title: Resort and Park Logistics
intel.text: Theme park lots are massive and utilize tram transfers; note your row and section upon arrival. Downtown Winter Park offers free street parking with strict time limits enforced daily.

intel.title: Connectivity and Apps
intel.text: Reliable signal is standard, but high-density crowds in theme parks can slow data speeds. Use official park Wi-Fi for mobile food ordering and checking real-time wait estimates.

intel.title: Corridor Supply
intel.text: Services are frequent along International Drive and the 192 corridor. Ensure adequate fuel before taking the Florida Turnpike or heading to remote nature preserves.

intel.title: The Rope Drop Strategy
intel.text: For theme parks and springs alike, arrival 30 minutes before opening is the primary way to avoid peak queues. Afternoon hours are best reserved for indoor museums or hotel amenities.

intel.title: Toll Road Navigation
intel.text: Many Central Florida expressways require electronic tolling; verify if your rental includes a transponder. The SunRail provides weekday commuter service between Orlando and Winter Park.

plan.arrival: Pick up vehicle at MCO and drive to Kissimmee or Lake Buena Vista for supply runs and check-in.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable; check rental policies regarding tolls and off-road use.
plan.goldenHour: Lake Eola Park in Downtown Orlando offers skyline reflections at dusk; seasonal events may affect path access.
